home.intro: The psychological support offered focuses on looking for the roots of distress, analysing lived situations, and inviting deeper understanding of why one or more symptoms appear, in order to achieve improvement.

services.metaDescription: Psychology and psychotherapy services in Granollers and online.
services.title: Some of the situations addressed in consultation may include:
items: Support with parenting from pregnancy onwards
Support in establishing feeding, sleep and stimulation routines for babies
Support with challenging behaviour in children
Support in personal and/or family crisis situations
Support during divorce and separation, with or without dependent children
Support for people who have suffered sexual abuse

profile.metaDescription: Professional background, education and teaching experience of Reme Rubio.
education: Interuniversity Master's Degree in Educational Psychology (UB 2009)
Master's Degree in "Psychotherapy with children and adolescents in clinical and educational settings" (ECPNA and IL3-UB 2023)
Master's Degree in "Psychoanalytic Clinical Practice with children and adolescents - FEAP Accreditation" (ECPNA 2025)
professional: Psychologist technician at the International Adoption Service (Intress)
Director of a residential care centre for children and adolescents (Intress 2017-2025)
Psychologist technician and coordinator of the City 2 BCN Technical Meeting Point Service (Intress 2012-2017)
profile.teachingIntro: Associate lecturer at the Faculty of Psychology (UAB):
teachingCourses: "Childhood and Families in contexts of Difficulty"
teachingPrograms: Master's Degree in Psychosocial Intervention and Research (MURIP)
Master's Degree in Legal and Forensic Psychology
teachingCollaborations: Speaker collaborator with the Barcelona Education Consortium
Collaborator at the Faculty of Psychology (UOC 2011-2012)
